rows.Name: Satin cowl slip dress
rows.Summary: A short ivory slip dress in fluid satin with a soft cowl neck.
rows.Description: Cut on the bias so it skims rather than clings, with thin adjustable straps and a draped cowl at the front. Wear it alone in summer or over a fine knit when the evenings turn.

rows.Name: Jersey pencil midi dress
rows.Summary: A stone-coloured long-sleeve midi in heavy jersey with a front slit.
rows.Description: A clean V-neck, fitted waist seam and a centre-front slit that makes walking easy. The jersey is dense enough to hold its line and soft enough to wear all day.

rows.Name: Cotton V-neck cardigan
rows.Summary: A boxy sage cardigan in a fine cotton rib, cropped at the hip.
rows.Description: Dropped shoulders, a deep V and five tonal buttons. Light enough for a cool summer evening, easy to layer over a slip or a shirt when it gets colder.

rows.Name: Chunky rib cardigan
rows.Summary: A heavyweight fisherman-rib cardigan with a V-neck, in three colours.
rows.Description: Knitted in a thick half-cardigan stitch that gives it body without weight. Long cuffs you can fold back and a single row of horn-look buttons.

rows.Name: Cotton trench coat
rows.Summary: A classic double-breasted trench in sand cotton gabardine.
rows.Description: Storm flap, epaulettes, a back yoke and a self belt at the waist. The cotton is tightly woven so it shrugs off a shower and softens with wear.

rows.Name: Check double-breasted blazer
rows.Summary: A grey Prince of Wales check blazer with black buttons.
rows.Description: Peak lapels, a longer line and a slightly oversized shoulder. Wear it over a slip dress or with trousers and the matching mood of a suit without the suit.

rows.Name: Wide-leg tailored trousers
rows.Summary: High-waisted camel trousers with front pleats and a wide leg.
rows.Description: A curved high waistband, two front pleats and a leg that falls straight to the floor. Side seam splits at the hem let them move.

rows.Name: Pleated wool-blend mini skirt
rows.Summary: A charcoal mini skirt with soft pleats and an A-line shape.
rows.Description: Sits at the natural waist and flares slightly over the hips. The wool blend has a fine brushed surface and a lining so it does not catch on tights.

rows.Name: Lace-up leather boot
rows.Summary: A black pebbled-leather lace-up boot on a chunky lug sole.
rows.Description: Eight eyelets, an inside zip so you do not have to unlace, and a deep-tread sole that grips on wet cobbles. Ankle height.

rows.Name: Buckle strap heeled boot
rows.Summary: A cognac leather boot with a suede shaft, buckle strap and block heel.
rows.Description: Hand-burnished leather that darkens at the toe, a suede panel at the shaft and an outside zip. The stacked block heel is 7 cm on a treaded sole.

rows.Name: Leather platform sneaker
rows.Summary: A white leather low-top on a stitched platform cupsole.
rows.Description: Smooth leather upper, flat waxed laces and a 4 cm cupsole that adds height without weight. Wipes clean.

rows.Name: Metallic leather sneaker
rows.Summary: A silver leather low-top with a perforated toe.
rows.Description: The same platform last as our white sneaker in a soft metallic leather. Perforations at the toe box keep it breathable.

rows.Name: Padded block-heel mule
rows.Summary: A black leather mule with a padded, top-stitched strap and a white block heel.
rows.Description: Three puffed leather bands with contrast stitching across the front, on a 7 cm stacked heel. Cushioned insole for a full day on your feet.

rows.Name: Kitten-heel pump
rows.Summary: A pointed pump on a low 5 cm kitten heel, in ivory or red snake.
rows.Description: A sharp toe and a low heel make this the pump you can actually wear to work. Both colours are cut from the same last.

rows.Name: Croc-embossed leather tote
rows.Summary: A navy leather tote with a croc-embossed front panel and zip pockets.
rows.Description: Smooth leather sides, a metallic croc-embossed panel and two vertical zip pockets on the front. Fits a laptop and closes with a top zip.

rows.Name: Slouch leather shoulder bag
rows.Summary: A soft cognac leather shoulder bag with gathered sides and a buckle strap.
rows.Description: Vegetable-tanned leather that softens and darkens with use. Long shoulder straps, a gathered body and a buckled tab at each end.

rows.Name: Top-handle satchel
rows.Summary: A structured teal leather satchel with a push-lock clasp.
rows.Description: A rigid body, a single rolled top handle and a detachable shoulder strap. The gold-tone push lock and feet on the base keep it looking new.

rows.Name: Printed silk square, Tide
rows.Summary: A 90 cm silk twill square in orange, cobalt and ink.
rows.Description: An abstract wave print with a hand-rolled hem. Tie it at the neck, around a bag handle or in your hair.

rows.Name: Printed silk square, Saffron
rows.Summary: A 90 cm silk twill square in saffron yellow with an orange border.
rows.Description: A lighter print from the same series, with fine illustrated detail on a yellow ground. Hand-rolled hem.

rows.Name: Pearl link necklace
rows.Summary: A gold-plated chain with freshwater pearls and a crystal heart drop.
rows.Description: Short oval links alternate with small freshwater pearls, finished with a faceted crystal set in a gold heart. Sits just below the collarbone.

rows.Name: Crystal eternity band
rows.Summary: A gold-plated eternity ring set all round with clear crystals.
rows.Description: Square-cut stones in a fine claw setting that runs the full circle. Wear it alone or stacked.
